item.tib: sgrib sbyong skor bzhi'i sgom bzlas tshogs khrid kyi rim pa gsal bar bkod pa gzhan phan nyi ma'i 'od zer
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni dad pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gzungs sngags dang snying po la bzlas brjod gtso bor bgyid pa rnams kyi dmigs sgom gyi ched dang*/ rgyal khams rnams su 'gro don la spyod pa'i bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te gter gzhung gi dgongs pa dang yig rnying las byung ba rnams legs par bsdus te rtsa tshig rnams thod (tho)bkod bgyis pa las/ slar yang zab gter bstan pa'i bdag por lung gis zin pa'i mchog spral g.yung drung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dbang po'i zhal snga nas tshogs khrid rgyas par spel dgos pa'i bka'i me tog spyi bor blang zhing (blangs shing) / nye char khyung dbon dam pa g.yung drung bdud 'dul nas rtsom 'phro rnams mthar phyung dgos pa'i bskul ma nan tan gnang bas kyang dran pa'i gsos btab ste/ snyigs dus kyi bon smra ba'i btsun pa bya bral ba dbra rigs khod spungs kyi rgyud du byung ba'i gshen gyi drang srong bskal (skal) bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam gzhan phan phrin las rgya mtsho zhes ming du 'bod pas rang gnas dbra khyung sA la'i ljongs kyi nags mthong dben par nyams len gyi thun mtshams su lhag bsam dge ba dang bcas te legs par sbyar ba'o//
